verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly list continuous batching and chunked prefill, and say advanced scheduling ensures peak GPU utilization. Bundled benchmark tooling measures serving throughput. Community users independently confirm they build on vLLM's continuous batching and credit batching and chunking as key to its performance. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring and tuning chunked prefill, and quantitative throughput results in the evidence.
